description: Writes down a prediction BEFORE the fact, with a probability, in the local ledger ~/.suunto-mcp/predictions.json (SUUNTO_PREDICTIONS_PATH overrides it). Writes only that file, never contacts Suunto, needs no Suunto credentials. A prediction is immutable once logged: it cannot be edited or deleted, only voided (void_prediction, with a reason, on a day before its `date`). The server scores it itself later (score_predictions) from Suunto's data and the journal, and get_prediction_stats says whether the stated probabilities were any good. `date` is the local day the prediction is about: strictly AFTER today (the server's local date: a prediction is about the future, so today is refused too) and at most 60 days ahead. `kind` is one of: 'session_done' (a workout exists on `date`), 'hrv_in_band' (the night AFTER `date`, the one leading into the next morning, has an HRV within the user's own p25..p75 band as get_baselines shows it, edges included), 'recovery_morning_at_least' (plus `threshold`, a Balance from 0 to 1 where x100 is the watch's Resources %: the morning recovery after the night after `date` is at least that), 'reps_hit' (plus `exercise`, `sets`, `reps` and optionally `kg`: on `date`, at least that many sets reached that many reps at that weight or more; the watch records only the guide's text, so this is scored from log_session entries and can be 'unresolvable' until the sets are logged). `probability` 0 to 1 is how likely the prediction is to come true in the caller's honest judgement; `rule` optionally names the rule or skill that made it, for the per-rule statistics; `note` is free text. A prediction identical to one still open (same kind, date and kind-specific fields; probability, note and rule do not count) is refused with the id of the open one, because it would count twice in the statistics. A prediction is due, and scored, from the second day after `date` (a day's data may sync late). Unknown fields and fields that do not belong to the kind are refused. At most 2000 predictions. Output: { saved: { id, madeAt, date, kind, probability, ..., due }, predictions (the count), note }. Not read-only (writes the ledger), not destructive (adds an entry), not idempotent (the same call again adds another prediction, or is refused as a duplicate). In demo mode the ledger is kept in memory.

date.description: The local day the prediction is about, YYYY-MM-DD: after today, at most 60 days ahead.

exercise.description: reps_hit: the exercise name as in get_exercise_history.

kg.description: reps_hit: the weight, in kg, at which each set is predicted to reach the reps (that or more). Leave out for any weight.

kind.description: What is predicted: session_done, hrv_in_band, recovery_morning_at_least or reps_hit.

probability.description: How likely it is to come true, 0 to 1.

rule.description: The rule or skill that made the prediction, e.g. 'weekly-plan'.

sets.description: reps_hit: how many sets are predicted to reach the reps.

threshold.description: recovery_morning_at_least: the Balance on waking, 0 to 1 (0.6 = 60% Resources).

name: log_prediction
title: Log a prediction before the fact (local ledger, immutable)
